protocol.candidate: Average probabilities from fixed-anchor models fitted to moving two-day training blocks
protocol.fitting: Same L2 .1 and coefficient bounds +/-.25; each member fits its own training-only scaler
protocol.resampling: Sample nonwrapping contiguous day blocks with replacement until original day count, truncate last block
protocol.guard: 5th/95th percentile across fitted models, clamped toward market to prevent side reversal
protocol.interpretation: Model dispersion is training-sample sensitivity, NOT a calibrated confidence interval
protocol.primary: Same 1000 bankroll, 1% sizing, .04 edge, .02 slippage and .07 fees
protocol.restrictions: Previously inspected development data; no threshold/weight search, holdout access or automatic deployment
